title: Can Finetuing LLMs on Small Human Samples Increase Heterogeneity, Alignment, and Belief-Action Coherence?

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Jensen-Shannon (JS) distance between LLM-simulated belief distributions and empirical human survey data across specific ethnic subgroups (White, Asian, Black, Mixed, Other) to evaluate representational fidelity, subgroup alignment, and the phenomenon of identity flattening.
